name: Fast Duty
body:
You are quick and precise in the pursuit of your office.

Prerequisite(s): Office class feature.

Benefit: The action required to activate an office ability becomes a step faster. A standard action becomes a move action; a move action becomes a swift action; and a swift action becomes an immediate action. This feat doesn’t affect abilities that are already activated as an immediate or free action.
